notes: The coach's workout debrief now finishes even if you leave the screen, and you can read the full debrief any time on that workout's page in your journal. Smarter suggestions: after a painful set on a light weight, the app can raise the load again later. Workouts you log for a past day no longer confuse the next suggestion or hide personal records. Notes like "easy" or «صعب» on old sets now count the same way everywhere. Plus behind-the-scenes cleanups and more tests.
